messages:
Carter: Heads up — planning to enable catalog model `orion-quant-v2` tomorrow in the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Goal: perf/cost improvement for low-latency chat workloads. Need: rollout plan, fallback ordering, pinned list for Dedicated, and release notes. Proposing soft canary 5% in us-west-2 first.

Erin: 👍 5% sounds reasonable. What's the concrete rollback criteria?

Carter: Fail conditions I'm proposing: error rate increase > 1.5% sustained for 5m OR P95 token latency > 450ms for 5m. Auto-fallback target: `orion-1.2-std`. Manual rollback command: `/deploy rollback catalog orion-quant-v2 --reason="canary-signal"`.

Ben: adding: if model decode quality drops measured by rate of regen requests > 3% vs baseline on the canary prompts set, that's also a rollback. We'll run the eval suite during canary.

Alice: For Dedicated customers we need a pin manifest and a staged pin runbook. Who owns generating the manifest?

Ben: I'll produce the pin manifest. Will include customer IDs and reason codes.

Frank: I'll wire up dashboards: model_p95, model_error_rate, regen_rate, and token_cost_delta. Alerting: pager if error_rate >1% for more than 10m OR p95 >500ms for 10m (ops threshold). SRE to confirm escalation path.

sre-bot: @SREs FYI — deploy window scheduled, please review on-call rota.

Carter: Fallback ordering proposal (priority high->low): 1) orion-1.2-std (same arch, fp16), 2) orion-quant-v1 (previous quant), 3) fallback-legacy (cpu). Regions: start us-west-2, then eu-west-1, then global.

Erin: Do we need a temporary traffic cap per region to avoid overwhelming caches? Suggest: cap max rps per instance to 30 during canary.

Carter: Good call. Add cap to rollout config.

Ben: Draft rollout config (will commit to infra repo):

```
{
  "model": "orion-quant-v2",
  "canary": {
    "start_pct": 5,
    "regions": ["us-west-2"],
    "duration_minutes": 30
  },
  "ramp": [30, 60, 100],
  "fallback_order": ["orion-1.2-std", "orion-quant-v1", "fallback-legacy"],
  "pinned_customers": ["cust-2345","cust-9981"],
  "rps_cap_per_instance": 30
}
```

Alice: I'll draft release notes and a short TL;DR for the product changelog. Include: quantized fp8 path, ~30% token cost reduction on chat traces, minor differences in tokenization edge-cases (covered by eval).

release-bot: Release notes stub created: `docs/releases/orion-quant-v2-2026-04-05.md` — please review.

Carter: Action items: Ben (pin manifest + infra PR), Alice (release notes + changelog blurb), Frank (dashboards + alerts), Erin (run eval suite & signoff), SREs (on-call confirmation). Target: canary go/no-go in #eng-releases 15m before 02:15 UTC.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary start for `orion-quant-v2` at 2026-04-05T02:15:00Z (us-west-2, 5%). Job id: db-72419.

Erin: I'll kick off the automated eval now and post results.

Erin: Eval results: regen delta 0.9% vs baseline, semantic BLEU within noise, perf P95 improved ~80ms. No obvious safety regressions on our prompt suite.

Carter: Great. If SREs are happy, proceed with scheduled canary.

sre-bot: On-call confirmed for the window: pager coverage from 02:00-05:00 UTC, escalation to @Frank if alerts fire.

deploy-bot: Canary started: db-72419 -> orion-quant-v2 at 2026-04-05T02:15:00Z. Routing: 5% traffic in us-west-2.

Frank: Dashboard link: https://console.redwood/monitoring/dashboards/orion-quant-v2-canary (prepopulated panels). Watching p95 and error_rate.

Carter: If canary is stable for 30m, plan: ramp to 30% and add eu-west-1 canary at 5% concurrently, then 60%/100% over next 3 hours. We'll update this thread with each step.

Ben: Pin manifest PR: https://git.redwood/pins/orion-quant-v2-pins — includes cust-2345 opt-out flag handled.

Alice: Release notes PR up: https://git.redwood/docs/orion-quant-v2-release-notes. QA review requested.

Erin: Can we add a quick note in the console about possible tokenization diffs for some emoji sequences? Small risk but callout is useful.

Carter: Yes — Alice can include that in the blurb.

deploy-bot: Canary update: 2026-04-05T02:45:00Z — 30m elapsed, no critical alerts. Observed: p95 lower by 60ms, error_rate delta +0.2%. Awaiting SRE signoff to ramp.

sre-bot: SRE signoff: proceed to ramp to 30% in us-west-2 and start eu-west-1 at 5%.

Carter: Proceeding with ramp now. Will post next status.

(End of thread)
